{{Short description|none}} The '''monarchs of the Kingdom of England''' ruled from the union under [[Athelstan]] in 927 until 1707. This is a '''list of the kings and queens of England'''. The first king was [[Alfred the Great]].
== House of Plantagenet == The [[House of Plantagenet]] produced several notable kings, including [[Henry II of England|Henry II]] and [[Richard I of England|Richard the Lionheart]].
<ref>Stenton, Anglo-Saxon England.</ref>
The '''Kingdom of England''' was a [[sovereign state]] on the island of [[Great Britain]] from 927 until 1707, ruled by a succession of [[monarch|kings]].
An '''automobile''', or '''car''', is a wheeled [[motor vehicle]] used for [[transport]]. Most definitions say cars run primarily on [[road]]s.
